settings.heading: Materials and stone
settings.rows:
Metal | 18k gold or platinum, your choice
Setting | Four-claw, cut-down
Stone | Natural or lab-grown diamond
Colour / clarity | F–G, VS or better
Certification | GIA or IGI, supplied
Band width | 1.9mm
Hallmark | London Assay Office

settings.heading: Care
settings.text: Remove before swimming, sport and sleep. Clean with warm water, a drop of unscented soap and a soft brush. We re-polish and re-set complimentary, for as long as you wear it.

settings.heading: Made to order
settings.text: This piece is begun after you order it. Allow six to nine weeks from confirmation to hallmark. If you need it sooner, tell us — we can sometimes move a commission forward.

settings.heading: Delivery and returns
settings.text: Complimentary insured, signed-for delivery worldwide. Fourteen days to return an unworn stock design for a full refund. Bespoke commissions and engraved pieces are not returnable, which we will say clearly before you commit.

settings.tax_note: Duties and taxes calculated at checkout
settings.assurances: Complimentary insured delivery worldwide, Complimentary resizing within the first year, Lifetime cleaning and re-polishing
